svg.title: Forest Service — Parks lower plate
svg.desc: Reference-based reconstruction. Not an official master or an embroidery stitch file. Forestry/Parks transition-style composition, kept separate from direct Ministry of Forests items. Plate, pale border and thin lettering need individual specimen fitting.
